title: API: search, return picker and credit list flag an inactive part; search flags an untracked part
custom_preconds: QA env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com (S2 shop), location Staging Heavy Duty. Logged in as Admin. QAPL-I1 is inactive here (set inactive after the deploy, so its search document is reindexed); QAPL-U1 is untracked. A paid part sale at Staging Heavy Duty that sold an inactive part: if none exists, activate QAPL-I3 (Inactive tab > Activate parts), sell 1 on a part sale and take payment, then deactivate QAPL-I3 again. DevTools Network tab open.
custom_steps:
1. Press Ctrl+K and type "QAPL-I1"; in Network open the GET /api/search response.
  2. Press Ctrl+K and type "QAPL-U1"; open the GET /api/search response.
  3. Parts > Returns > Create Return; in Part Number type "QAPL-I1".
  4. In Network open the GET /api/inventory/parts?search=QAPL-I1 request sent by the return part picker.
  5. Cancel the return. Open the paid part sale that sold QAPL-I3 and click Issue credit memo.
  6. In Network open GET /api/part-sales/<invoiceId>/list-credit-available-parts.
custom_expected:
1. The QAPL-I1 hit has isActive false; the row shows a grey "Inactive" tag.
  2. The QAPL-U1 hit has isTracked false; the row shows "Not Tracked" in place of "{n} available".
  3. QAPL-I1 is offered with a grey "Inactive" tag (pill_part_select_inactive_...).
  4. The request carries no status parameter; 200, and QAPL-I1 is listed with is_active false.
  5. QAPL-I3 is listed with the grey "Inactive" tag (pill_parts_return_inactive_{id}) beside its part number and can be selected for credit.
  6. 200; the QAPL-I3 entry has isInventoryPartInactive true.
